body.title: Implement verifyManagerClosureCoverage
body.summary: verifyManagerClosureCoverage(repoPath, targets, manager, manifestDir) re-resolves a manager's required-input closure (nested -r/-c references for pip-family; a go module's full source tree for go) fresh on every call, and returns covered:true or covered:false with the missing files listed. Never caches a prior result.
acceptanceChecks: a manager's closure fully contained in targets.entries -> covered:true
a manager's closure referencing a file outside targets.entries -> covered:false with that file listed in missing
two calls in a row after a new file is added to the closure return different results (no caching)
never mutates targets.entries or any other input

tests.name: verifyManagerClosureCoverage: re-resolves the closure fresh on each call -- two calls in a row after a file is added return different results
verifyManagerClosureCoverage: a closure fully contained in targets.entries -> covered:true
verifyManagerClosureCoverage: a closure referencing a file outside targets.entries -> covered:false with missing listed
